item.title: Dick Morris Warns China-Taiwan Comment Could Derail Graham's Senate Bid
item.description: Political consultant Dick Morris said on Newsmax Saturday that a shaky debate answer on Taiwan policy could hurt Senator Graham's re-election chances.

item.title: Data Center Opposition Grows Across Party Lines Before Midterms
item.description: Data centers have become a bipartisan issue ahead of the 2026 midterms, according to a Newsweek report on Saturday.

item.title: Colorado Teacher Faces Backlash Over Biological Truth Shirt
Teacher Fears Retaliation After Shirt Complaint
item.description: Stacy Adair says she was reprimanded for wearing an "XX ≠ XY" chromosome shirt to a training event, raising concerns about her job security.
